therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of mutant IDH1 enzyme to reduce oncometabolite production
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with advanced solid tumors and gliomas with IDH1 mutations

results.effect_size: ORR: Cohort 1A (glioma): 2/26 patients, Cohort 2A (hepatobiliary): 1/8 patients, other cohorts: 0 responses
results.target_engagement_evidence: CSF penetration demonstrated in glioma patients (mean concentration 27.15 ng/mL in Cohort 1A)
subgroup_findings: Responses observed only in glioma (Cohort 1A) and hepatobiliary tumors (Cohort 2A)
No responses in chondrosarcoma, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, or other solid tumors
safety_signals: Disease progression was most common serious adverse event
results.dose_information: 150 mg capsule, frequency and dose level per protocol (specific dosing not detailed)

context.duration: Treatment up to 2 years, follow-up up to 101 weeks
